shipToSitesLoaded.description: True once LoadShipToSitesChain has actually RUN the BIP report for the current project+contract. Distinguishes 'loaded, zero rows' (show 'No Location Found') from 'not fetched yet' — both leave shipToSitesAdp.data empty. Reset to false whenever the contract changes or is cleared.

True once LoadShipToSitesChain has actually RUN the BIP report for the current project+contract. Distinguishes 'loaded, zero rows' from 'not fetched yet' — both leave shipToSitesAdp.data empty, but only the first should show 'No Location Found'. Reset to false whenever the contract changes or is cleared.

contractsAdp.description: Plain page-level ADP for the Contract oj-select-single — populated by LoadContractsChain, which mutates .data IN PLACE (never replaces this object) so the component never sees a new data-provider reference and never flickers/remounts.

shipToSitesAdp.description: Plain page-level ADP for the Ship-to-Site oj-select-single — populated by LoadShipToSitesChain from the project+CONTRACT scoped report (every customer's sites on the contract), same in-place-mutation pattern as contractsAdp.

tasksDp.description: Task LOV data provider — the CHARGEABLE LEAVES of the selected project's WBS. Built in JS by resources/js/taskDataProvider.js and assigned by LoadTaskTreeChain, hence type 'any' rather than a vb/ ServiceDataProvider or ArrayDataProvider2 declaration. Two reasons it cannot be declarative: (1) showing leaves only means filtering on 'no other row names me as parent', a property of the whole set that no Fusion q predicate can express, so the rows must be fetched and classified in JS first; (2) it is handed over as a DeferredDataProvider wrapping the IN-FLIGHT fetch, so the dropdown renders JET's own loading skeleton and fills in place instead of the field being disabled shut mid-open. Resolves to an ArrayDataProvider keyed on TaskId with textFilterAttributes over TaskName/TaskNumber, so the dropdown's filter field matches locally with no round-trip.

customerRefsArray.description: EQR_CUSTOMER_REF rows for the EXTERNAL Customer Name picker. Loaded by LoadExternalPartyLovsChain. Same source and row shape { id, customerName } as customer-create-req-page, so an external request raised here is indistinguishable from one raised in the customer flow.

customerPortalUsersArray.description: EQR_CUSTOMER_PORTAL_USER rows for the EXTERNAL Customer Contact picker. ALL portal users, unfiltered — the contact LOV is INDEPENDENT of the chosen customer (there is no DB relationship between them), exactly as on customer-create-req-page. Loaded by LoadExternalPartyLovsChain.

lockedTypeArray.description: ONE-item list holding just the current Customer Type, for the locked (non-choosable) Customer Type box. Rendered as a white single-option LOV rather than a readonly text so it matches the other fields. Written by RequestTypeChangedChain.

requestorArray.description: ONE-item list holding just the signed-in user, for the locked INTERNAL Requestor Contact box. Keyed by display name because an unmatched user has no EQR_USER id. Written by SeedRequestorChain.

invOrgLocationSDP.description:
Delivery Location LOV when Location Type = 'Internal Location'. Server-driven off EQR_BU_ORG_MAPPING via eqp-v1/bu-org-mappings, active rows only, search-as-you-type over invOrgName/invOrgCode/townOrCity. SCOPED TO orgRole=DESTINATION_YARD: the field answers 'where does the equipment go TO', so it offers destinations only — not the EQUIPMENT_YARD rows (sources) and not the VIRTUAL_* rows (Fusion transfer-order plumbing, no physical address). DESTINATION_YARD was added to CHK_BOM_ORG_ROLE in schema v302.

ADDRESS COMES FROM THE MAPPING ROW, NOT A LIVE CALL. EQR_BU_ORG_MAPPING already carries the hr_locations address (addressLine1..4, townOrCity, region1..3, postalCode, country) plus invOrgLatitude/invOrgLongitude, written by resources/js/invOrgAddress.js when the admin saves the mapping — it calls BIP /Custom/EquipRite/EQP_INV_ORG_ADDRESSES.xdo and geocodes the result. So the picker needs no BIP or geocoder call of its own: selecting a row already has the full address AND coordinates in hand. Verified live 2026-08-20 — Chicago (003) '233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago IL 60606' and Boise (004) '1314 W Grove St, Boise ID 83702', both with lat/long.

selectedInvOrgLocationId.description: invOrgId chosen in the 'Select Inv org' Delivery Location LOV. The human-readable org name is what gets written to request.location (see the on-value-changed handler), because every downstream consumer — geocoder, NavigateToCatalogChain validation, SubmitRequestChain — expects location to be an address-like string, not an id.

selectedInvOrgLocationItem.description: oj-select-single value-item {key,data,metadata} for the inv-org Delivery Location picker. Same reason as selectedYardItem on request-detail-page: bu-org-mappings cannot resolve a single invOrgId via fetchByKeys, so the component needs the whole item to render the selected label.

requestTypeSel.description: PAGE-level mirror of the Request Type picker, and the value every oj-bind-if on this page tests. The select binds HERE, not directly to $flow.variables.request.requestType: writing a NESTED property of a $flow object variable does not reliably re-evaluate oj-bind-if (the flow variable's own reference never changes), so the External/Internal fields did not appear when the type was switched. Same page-scalar + mirror-into-$flow shape the Location Type picker above already uses. RequestTypeChangedChain copies it onto $flow.variables.request.requestType, which stays the value that travels to the cart and gets posted.

taskTree.description: WBS classification of the selected project's tasks — { summaryIds, depthById, basis } from resources/js/projectTaskTree.js, rebuilt by LoadTaskTreeChain whenever the project changes. tasksSDP returns a FLAT list, so this is the only thing that knows '1.1' is a summary node and '1.1.1.1' is the chargeable leaf. Drives the dropdown's indent + greying, and TaskSelectedChain refuses a summary pick against it. Empty object until loaded, which reads as 'every task is a leaf' — the picker then behaves exactly as it did before this existed.

taskError.description: Inline message under the Task field when the user picks a summary task. Cleared on a valid pick and on project change.

tasksCacheKey.description: ProjectId whose tasks tasksDp currently holds. Lets LoadTaskTreeChain leave the provider untouched when the project has not changed — rebuilding it would make an already-resolved list skeleton again for no reason. Set only after a successful fetch, so it can never claim a project the provider does not actually hold.

isLocationDrawerOpen.description: Controls the right-side Delivery Location map drawer (oj-drawer-popup). Auto-opens when Location Type = Enter Delivery location.

locationSearchText.description: Free-text address typed into the drawer's search box; the page module geocodes it and centres the map.

addr1.description: Address Line 1 (Oracle HZ_LOCATIONS.ADDRESS1) — street number + name, parsed from the geocode result.

addr2.description: Address Line 2 (suite/unit) — Mapbox doesn't provide this; user-editable.

customerSearchRequested.description: Fired by the page module's customer ReportSuggestProvider when oj-input-search asks it for suggestions, carrying the typed text, so CustomerTypeaheadChain can run the BIP report EQP_CUSTOMERS_LOV_RP. The chain answers through $page.functions.deliverCustomers(text, rows).

projectSearchRequested.description: Fired by the page module's ProjectSuggestProvider when oj-input-search asks it for suggestions, carrying the typed text, so ProjectTypeaheadChain can run the BIP report (a page module cannot call it). The chain answers through $page.functions.deliverProjects(text, rows).

locationResolved.description: Fired by the page module after a geocode/reverse-geocode with the parsed Oracle-style address components + coords, so a chain can write them into the page variables (module can't write variables directly).
